knowledge.purpose: Single-line text input field bound to form state with validation messaging
useCases: Single-line free text (title, name, search query)
antiPatterns: Choice from a fixed list — use form.select
Boolean value — a text field is the wrong shape; offer both answers with form.segmented-control
knowledge.implementation:
Further use cases:
- Numeric value entry (with type=number)

With `stateKey` the field carries a declarative setState on change, the same way segmented-control and pagination do: a data source whose query reads `{{state.<key>}}` re-queries as the visitor types.

To let something else change the box (a suggestion chip writing `q`, a Clear button), also bind `value` to the same key: `"stateKey": "q", "value": "{{state.q}}"`. The field writes the key as the visitor types and shows a value set from outside, without remounting. The visible label is tied to the native field (`<label for>` → the field’s own id), so the field has an accessible name.

jsonSchema.description: textarea renders a multi-line field (prefer form.textarea, which carries resize and maxLength). hidden is a carry field: no label and nothing on screen, its defaultValue (or bound value) is submitted with the form — use it instead of style.display none.
Keep the label as the accessible name but do not draw it (a search box whose toolbar already says what it searches). With no label at all the field is named by its placeholder, else its name.
Lowest accepted value — a number for type=number, an ISO date/time string for date/time types.
Highest accepted value — a number for type=number, an ISO date/time string for date/time types.
Granularity for number/date/time values. Set 0.01 (or "any") for money and decimals — without it type=number accepts whole numbers only.
What the visitor reads when the text does not match pattern, in human words ("Enter a UK postcode, e.g. XX1 2AB") — replaces the browser default "Please match the requested format."

What the browser may fill in (the HTML autocomplete token: "name", "street-address", "one-time-code"…). Unset: a password field is current-password (new-password inside a form whose submit registers), an e-mail field email, a phone field tel.
Name of an icon rendered inside the field on the leading (left) edge. One of: search, check, x, mail, lock, eye, user, phone, calendar, bell, globe. Ignored for type=textarea.
Name of an icon rendered inside the field on the trailing (right) edge. One of: search, check, x, mail, lock, eye, user, phone, calendar, bell, globe. Ignored for type=textarea.
Initial value — expression-bindable ({{source[0].Field}}); applied by remount once the data resolves. With display:none it forms the hidden-field pattern.

The value page state holds for this field — bind it to the key it writes ("{{state.q}}" beside stateKey "q"). A change from outside (a suggestion chip, a reset) is shown in the box; the echo of the visitor’s own typing is ignored, so the field never remounts mid-word.
